notes.title: Two new games coming soon
notes.content:
Hello gentlemen, this time I would like to bring you two new trailers, "Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" and "Lovelorn sanatorium III", both of which are the sequels of the previous games. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2157680/_/
"Lunar Mirror: The Pavilion of Desire" is a derivative work of "Lunar Mirror". It tells the story of an ordinary college student in a remote archaeological school who was abandoned by his girlfriend, joined the school's mysterious party, and met different people. The story of a girl who is finally tempted into the abyss. There are also a large number of mini-games in the game for players to experience.
You thought that you would be like the protagonist, who would retreat after discovering all the secrets, but you are actually just an ordinary passerby, and you will only walk towards the trap that has been prepared for you step by step with hope...
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2307120/_/
"Lovelorn sanatorium Ⅲ" is the continuation of the Lovelorn sanatorium series. The game continues with the game setting of the Bitter Lord series. What strange cases will the protagonists Zhang Ji and Jibotu encounter this time.
The game adopts a dynamic comic performance method, with rich pictures and simple gameplay. It cooperates with the mini-game puzzle-solving gameplay to bring players a new and unique experience. The overall story plot is humorous and contains many popular hot spots.
Not much to say, gentlemen, please add to the wish list. There will be a reminder when the game is released, and there will be a 10% discount for the first release of the game. Don't miss it!

notes.title: Lunar Mirror will be officially launched on Steam EA on January 19
notes.content:
Hi, gentlemen
we decided to officially launch "Lunar Mirror" on steam EA on January 19. The EA version of "Lunar Mirror" will contain all the contents of the first chapter. you can experience it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/Lunar_Mirror/
"Lunar Mirror" is a horror puzzle game with amazing elements. A sudden astronomical anomaly led to the disappearance of students one after another, and a mysterious society that is happy with love is quietly rising again. What is the connection between your missing girlfriend and them? With the deepening of the investigation, the history of the campus slowly surfaced, but the truth became more complicated

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42201006/6bbd18e40fc565f1a631f76cddf2f340ed307f27.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Why are the girls missing in school
[*] Why are boys keen on midnight activities organized by clubs
[*] What happened ten years ago? Why did the school move to the barren mountains
[*] What kind of conspiracy is the mysterious rising society planning on campus
[*] Religion with childbearing as its theme, combined with horror elements and stunning stimulation, brings new sensory experiences.
[/list]
[h2][b]Note: Friendly tips. First of all, this game is a horror game, followed by the feature content. The game contains thriller elements, so buy carefully!!![/b][/h2]

Finally, I wish you a happy new year in advance

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910790/_/

notes.title: Good news! We have three games with confirmed release dates
notes.content:
Hi gentlemen, how are you?
Long time no see, it has been a long time since our last game released, so this time we will release 3 games in early October.
They are "[b]Lost 2[/b]", the sequel to the "Lost" interactive puzzle series, the partner's match-3 game "[b]Valhalla: Valkyrie Awakening[/b]" and AVG "[b]Yusetsu[/b]"

[h2]Lost 2[/h2]
The work "Lost 2" inherits the click and decryption gameplay of "Lost 1", the original "Lost" series, but "Lost 2" focuses on the dark fairy tale style. Players will shuttle in the fairy tale dream and help the fairy tale princess to solve one trouble after another, of course, you can also make a little trouble to embarrass them~

[h2]Yusetsu[/h2]
After waiting for a long time, "Yusetsu" will also meet all players this holiday!
The story takes place in a love bar called "Yusetsu". Players will play a man who was dumped at Christmas, and then came to the bar, and embarked on a love journey with three girls in the bar. The main features of the game are lovely story and exquisite Live2D,  we hope this game can warm your heart.

[h2]Valhalla: Valkyrie Awakening[/h2]
The third game, "Valhalla: Valkyrie Awakening", is our partner's game. Players will play Odin and conquer the Valkyries under their command. This is a game that focuses on match-3 gameplay. I hope to bring you a smooth match-3 journey. Every time you clear a Valkyrie, you can also unlock some small benefits~

Three styles of games to meet your various needs, interested friends can add a wish list first, there is a discount for the first release, don't miss it!
Join our player community now and you can also participate in activities such as testing and sending keys before the game is released! Come fast!
Discord: https://discord.gg/t7FMzSwyDx
Twitter: https://twitter.com/dsgamex
Finally, we sincerely wish you all -  牛牛不倒！

notes.title: Hi, gentlemen, "Lost 2" is coming!
notes.content:
hello gentlemen

This time, we bring you a new work from our partner, the third work of the "Lost" series - "Lost 2"!
This is a click and decrypt game with the theme of dark fairy tales. Players need to shuttle through dozens of dark dreams about fairy tales and help those famous fairy tale princesses out of trouble. Of course, you also need to cause some trouble every now and then to satisfy your evil desires and start having sweet and dark interactions with the princess.

The game will launch in October, and it's time to add the game to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1930640/Lost2/
[h3] More levels! [/h3]
Compared with the previous work, we have designed 39 levels to challenge based on fairy tales this time. Their themes are dark and gloomy, and these levels also have certain connections with each other.
At the same time, we also retain the familiar decryption gameplay. After entering the dream of the dark fairy tale, the player needs to solve the puzzle through observation and reasoning, so as to save the trapped princess step by step. You need to create a little more trouble to satisfy your evil desires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35831268/97e8019258842f77f860f5fbb05527727a4b61b6.gif[/img]
[h3]Fuller character design[/h3]
The game has a total of 27 delicate CGs for unlocking, they are all about the most famous princesses and other characters in fairy tales, we have also carefully designed the movements and poses of each character in the CG to make them delicate and rich enough.
Every time you rescue a princess, you will also unlock her exclusive picture book, and then by accessing the picture book, you can interact with the princesses in the way you want.
And this time, we also deliberately paved some small easter eggs in the game for players to discover~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35831268/07ea07eb8c7b0c0b4ab20e58d73feef7ffee8ad5.gif[/img]
We hope this game can take you to fall into and get lost in the magnificent dark fairy tales, escape from reality together, and appreciate the charm of dark fairy tales.
So if you want to know about Lost2 and our other games for the first time, or have any thoughts or comments on the game content, you can contact us in the following ways.

notes.title: The new game "Lunar Mirror" is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello gentlemen!
After a long period of development, our first horror game, Lunar Mirror, is finally here.
This time we have put a lot of energy into the gameplay, I believe that friends who like to explore game decryption will not be disappointed.

"Lunar Mirror" is a Cthulhu series of horror games, focusing on exploration and decryption.

The story takes place in a remote university, a sudden astronomical vision locks you and the whole school in the remote school, and your girlfriend leaves without saying goodbye, allowing you to start exploring the entire campus. The sudden rise of the mysterious society is related to your missing girlfriend, and they seem to take pleasure in love...
In order to find a girlfriend, you have to step into the darkness of the campus at night, explore the secrets buried in the campus, meet girls wandering around at night, encounter indescribable terror...until the moment when the truth comes
The game is currently in the pre-emptive version, and more plots will be unlocked later. At the same time, we will also update the game content in a timely manner based on player feedback, and welcome your comments and feedback. The subsequent chapters of the game are also in production, so stay tuned!
The game is about to be launched, you can add a wishlist first, there are discounts for the first launch, don't miss it!

notes.title: Fixed some bugs and responded to some common problems
notes.content:
0. Can't find how to play games, only table pets
Please right-click on the table pet.

1. The background of the desktop pet is black, can't see the things behind it?
Please set smoothing-FXAA in the NVIDIA control panel to off, please refer to the diagram for details.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526800/e3b644fc5bdab6b9fc8e04ffd02de49e603a4d55.png[/img]

2. How to set up auto-start after power-on
Currently this game does not have such a setting, please use a third-party solution.

3. Can pictures be saved?
Please click the link to save it yourself.

4. Can I use my own pictures or music?
Please drag your own pictures or music to the table pet.

5. What is the monitor mode?
Ananke can type with you.

6. What does the eye icon in the right-click menu mean?
One key switch all controls (including clock, pictures, music)

7. How to reset the progress of the on-hook game?
Go to the following directory C:\Users\your user name\AppData\LocalLow\DSGame\Lost Find and delete the game3.ds file. (Remember to backup before deleting)
